turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
You already know how to say what you do every day, like "I walk to school." Let us talk about yesterday.
Example: "Today I walk. Yesterday I walked." I added -ed to walk because the action is finished.
So the rule is: add -ed to a regular verb to talk about a finished action.
Right: She painted a chair yesterday. Wrong: She paint a chair yesterday.
Now you try. Write the missing word: "Yesterday I ___ (clean) my room."
